newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TEN CATE TO SELL TWO UNITS TO WAVIN.
newsitem.headline: TEN CATE TO SELL TWO UNITS TO WAVIN.

text.p: Dutch textiles firm Koninklijke Ten Cate NV said on Monday it had reached agreement in principle to sell its Viplex and Schinkel Schouten units to unlisted Dutch plastics maker Wavin BV.
The sale represents a continuation of the strategic reorganisation of Ten Cate, the company said, and was not expected to cost any jobs at the two businesses. No financial details were given.
"Inside Ten Cate, the possibilities for Viplex and Schinkel Schouten are limited," it said. "At Wavin, that focuses its activities on pipe systems, there are greater opportunities."
Viplex and Schinkel Schouten together have 150 employees and turn over around 70 million guilders a year, Ten Cate said.
Wavin is 50 percent owned by Royal Dutch/Shell.
